data.body: Already fixed: duplicate of aba6-56fa-8176-4801 (archived). check-sprint-trailer.sh now reads in-progress message via $1 or $GIT_DIR/COMMIT_EDITMSG (commit 3a11f3379f) and is registered at the commit-msg stage in .pre-commit-config.yaml:236 (commit 4b94a52fad). Tests: tests/hooks/test-check-sprint-trailer.sh PASSED 8/0 and tests/hooks/test-sprint-trailer-registration.sh PASSED 4/0. Closing as already-resolved.
